svg.title: Stockformer: Transformer-based time-series forecasting for stock
svg.desc: Hourly returns of several correlated oil stocks enter a sliding window; a 1D-CNN with kernel size 3 embeds each time step; an encoder with ProbSparse attention lets only a few active queries attend and max-pool distilling halves the sequence layer by layer; the output is turned into a position with tanh and the model is trained to maximize realized return rather than price error.

g.text: Input: hourly returns of correlated stocks
peers are Granger-causal for target XOM
O(L log L) instead of O(L²)
